incident: User reported splash-screen hang on TestFlight 1.0.7 after shopping/recipe OTA
recovery: Republished exact previous bundles for 1.0.5, 1.0.6, and 1.0.7; verified serving each runtime; annotated recovery tags pushed
findings: Failed 1.0.7 bytecode contains expected Clerk publishable key and approved Instant app ID
quantityWorkspaceAvailable compiles to true in both known-good and failed bundles
No native dependency or runtime configuration source changes between bundles
rootCause: Splash readiness required the tabs group. Restoring a saved shopping session navigated to the root-level shopping route before dismissal, so readiness never became true.
sourceState: Main and all three active release branches include shopping grouping, recipe cards, and both startup fixes; matching OTAs are published and delivery verified.
evidence: Device metadata proved both rollback and timer-fix bundles launched while splash remained visible
User confirmed opening chomp://grocery-lists immediately exposed the app
Device metadata confirms route-fix update 01a17686-9f7c-74c5-a2a1-9301116e58ec launched normally
User confirmed normal startup on route-fix update ending 58ec without the list-picker shortcut
additionalFix: Moved hidden flag into delayed callback to allow retry after effect cleanup; valid bug but insufficient alone for this incident.
recoveryStatus: Complete. User confirmed normal startup on 1.0.7 and explicitly approved rollout to 1.0.5 and 1.0.6. Both are published with runtime delivery verified. CI passed on main and all three release heads.
